_source: Claude Opus 5, 2026-08-01. Third pass: rows the earlier waves left because the units table had no volt, no mole and no electron-volt. Every id read from physics_catalog.json by name+equation. Rows whose equation is a PDE, a tensor identity or a symmetry statement are still skipped -- those have no scalar in and out, and no amount of unit vocabulary changes that.

E4.02.note: Lorentz F = q(E + v x B). The row that decides whether a charged particle in this world's magnetosphere reaches the ground -- aActiveInterior derives a dipole and publishes a surface field in microtesla, so the consuming half exists already.

E4.03.note: Ohm V = IR. Trivial and worth declaring: it is the socket every powered thing in a game eventually needs, and having it unbound is a fact about this tree, not about the physics.

E4.05.note: Friis P_r = P_t G_t G_r lambda^2/(4 pi r)^2. The inverse-square law with an aperture on each end -- what decides whether a suit radio reaches a base over this world's horizon.

E4.06.note: Faraday EMF = -dPhi/dt. A changing magnetic flux makes a voltage: motors, generators, and the induction that heats a planet's interior when its field moves.

E4.07.note: Nernst E = E0 - (RT/nF) ln Q. A battery's voltage falls as it discharges AND as it gets cold -- the second half is why a suit's endurance is a thermal problem as much as a chemical one.

E7.02.note: E_n = -13.6 eV/n^2. The hydrogen ladder, and therefore every spectral line an instrument in this game could ever read. Blocked until now by having no electron-volt.

E7.04.note: Tunnelling T ~ exp(-2 kappa L). Exponential in the barrier width, which is why it is negligible at every scale a person meets and total inside a star -- E8.04's fusion row is this row at stellar density.

E7.08.note: Shockley I = I_s(exp(qV/kT) - 1). The p-n junction, and the temperature in it is not decoration: a diode's curve moves with T, which is why electronics behave differently on a cold world.

E8.05.note: ~200 MeV per U-235 fission. ENERGY BALANCE ONLY -- the catalog's own scope line, and it is kept: nothing here touches device engineering, which THE_GROWTH lists among the forbidden branches.

E8.06.note: Absorbed dose = energy per mass. An earlier wave REFUSED this row on principle, because the gray shares the dimension L2T-2 exactly with N.m/kg and kWh/t, so borrowing one of those would have been a textbook misfold. Gy and Sv now exist as their own units, so the row can be stated without the lie.

E8.07.note: RTG: decay heat through a Seebeck couple. Same in and out unit, which is exactly the point -- the row IS the efficiency, and a signature that hides that would be useless.

E3.03.note: Boltzmann S = k ln W. theEmptying publishes an `S` of 8.67e-23 with no declared unit -- close to k itself -- and this row is what would bind it if the membrane said what it was.

E3.04.note: Clausius-Clapeyron dP/dT = L/(T dV). theOcean already lives off this row's answer -- 0.52 bar gives a 355 K boiling bracket -- but derives it from a table rather than the relation, so the law and its consumer have never met.

E3.06.note: Nu = f(Re, Pr). Wholly dimensionless in and out -- three numbers that between them decide whether heat leaves a surface by drifting or by being carried. The correlation itself is measured, and the row says so.

E9.08.note: Gravitational-wave strain -- a dimensionless stretch of space. Declared for completeness with nothing in this tree to bind it, and that is the honest state: a law with no consumer is not a gap in the law.

E10.08.note: Crater scaling: diameter from impact energy. theRockyPlanet already derives an obliquity from a stochastic giant-impact distribution -- the impacts are in this story's history and none of their craters are on its ground.

E1.04.note: Hamilton's equations. A dimensional signature cannot hold them -- q and p carry whatever units the system does -- but as a METHOD they are an integrator, and they land in the same socket as S1.03 and S3.01. That is not a coincidence: symplectic integrators are called symplectic because they preserve Hamiltonian structure.

E1.08.note: Lyapunov exponent from a trajectory. A method, not a law. And it is the measurement this studio already ran without naming it: the celebrated walker lost 5.5 body lengths to a one-micron nudge, which is a positive exponent reported as a robustness score.

E2.09.note: Kolmogorov -5/3. A field becomes a spectrum, and the CONTENT is the slope of it. Declared with the shape serial because that is what is true: a dimensional signature would say nothing, and the earlier wave was right to skip it rather than invent one.
